process.subtitle: Seven stages, one team, no hand-offs. Every step is signed off before the next begins.

steps.title: Brief & Strategy
steps.blurb: Share your campaign goals, target audience, and timeline. We build a deployment strategy around your objectives — not a generic package.

steps.title: Audience & Location Analysis
steps.blurb: Map your target audience against footfall data, event calendars, and high-traffic zones. We identify where your people are, then we plan to be exactly there.

steps.title: Traffic & Logistics Planning
steps.blurb: Route mapping, permits, city clearances, and deployment logistics: fully managed by our team. You approve the plan, we handle everything from road access to on-ground coordination.

steps.title: Creative & Wrap Design
steps.blurb: Our design team translates your brand into a full-vehicle wrap concept. You approve every detail before anything goes to print.

steps.title: Production & Wrap
steps.blurb: Cyber Stage is wrapped, the AV systems are configured, and content is loaded. Production takes 48–72 hours from final approval.

steps.title: Activation Day
steps.blurb: The Cyber Stage hits the road. Our crew manages every on-ground moment — positioning, content capture, audience engagement.

steps.title: Report & Debrief
steps.blurb: Full campaign report delivered within 48 hours: reach, footfall, content assets, social performance, and recommendations for the next phase.

items.a: Cyber Stage is a fully branded, AV-equipped mobile activation unit that deploys at your event, venue, or location. Full vehicle wrap in your identity, LED screens running your content, spatial audio — positioned exactly where your audience is. It's not just a logo slapped on a vehicle. It's a moving brand experience.

items.q: How fast can you deploy after we confirm?
items.a: Standard is 48–72 hours from brief approval to street. We've done 36 hours for urgent campaigns. The earlier you brief us, the better — but we're built to move fast.

items.q: Can we use it at our event venue specifically?
items.a: Yes — and that's actually one of the highest-impact uses. Positioning Cyber Stage at your venue entrance creates an immediate first impression before guests walk through the door. Koora Break and Tawuniya both did exactly this. It sets the tone for everything that follows.

items.q: Do you handle the wrap design or do we bring our own?
items.a: Both options work. Our in-house design team can translate your brand guidelines into a full wrap concept — or we work directly with your creative agency. You approve every detail before anything goes to production.
Currently active in Riyadh, Jeddah, Khobar, Mecca, and Medina. Dubai and Cairo available for multi-market packages. We handle all permits and logistics — you just send the brief.
One day. Most activations run 2–5 days for real impact. Multi-city campaigns run 5–14 days. We'll recommend the right duration based on your goals and budget — no upselling for the sake of it.
Every deployment includes an on-ground content crew. Reels, photos, behind-the-scenes — delivered to your team within 24 hours. You walk away with a full content library, not just the activation.

items.q: Do we get a report after the campaign?
items.a: Always. Footfall data, reach estimates, content performance, full photography, and a strategic debrief — packaged into a single report you can present to your CMO. Every number justified, every outcome documented.
